- Add c22 after c21: pointer templates, typed expressions, page formatting context and expression-local `_F`, with matching Python/JavaScript pages.
- Revisit the same CSS-width example to show how `:{}px` simplifies the earlier auxiliary-attribute template. Contrast boolean `:=!{}` with text templates, and text format/mask with attribute formatting.
- Migrate existing masks from `%s` to `{}` and improve Source/style/DOM explanations without changing the chronological learning route.
- Require core 0.2.20 or later, with no upper bound.

Verified: 67 JavaScript tests, 16 Python tests plus 58 subtests, and strict Sphinx/link/search/anchor validation of all 46 lessons and two paired guides.
